About me

Developer, analyst, trainer, team founder.

Hi, I'm Celia. I'm a web developer and data analyst who enjoys turning ideas into things people can actually use, from websites for real companies to tools that help children communicate and students learn.

I'm currently a member of EduTech (ET) in the programming and training sections, where I design and deliver workshops for students. Before that I was part of the programming section at Digital Fingers. I also founded the Hacktivators team and built its website.

On the data side, I've analyzed a restaurant's data and analyzed ML GitHub repositories for my final project. I've completed 9 courses with Huawei, courses with Cisco, and level 4 of the Digital Egypt Cubs initiative in AI and Data Science.

I believe in learning by building and then sharing it, which is why I teach: workshops on leadership, web development and emotional intelligence, plus an online web development course.
